# Eric Coulombe, Real Estate Advisor (Engel & Völkers Vancouver)

> Vancouver REALTOR® licensed since 2003, based at Engel & Völkers Vancouver's Kerrisdale office (2126 W. 41st Ave., Vancouver, BC). Two practices: advisory for Vancouver Westside and UBC homeowners, buyers and sellers (including UBC prepaid leasehold), and helping clients build cash-flow-positive small multi-family portfolios in Northern BC, especially Fort St. John. Phone 604-764-8620.

Updated 2026-11-13.

## Vancouver residential
- [UBC homes guide](https://ericcoulombe.com/ubc-utopianlifestyle.html): buying and selling at UBC, prepaid leasehold explained, neighbourhoods, schools and costs.
- [UBC and Musqueam leasehold houses](https://ericcoulombe.com/ubc-and-musqueam-leasehold-houses.html): how leasehold houses on UBC and Musqueam land work.
- [Buying a UBC condo for your student](https://ericcoulombe.com/buy-a-ubc-condo-for-your-student.html): buy vs. rent vs. residence for parents of UBC students.
- [Buying](https://ericcoulombe.com/buying.html) and [Selling](https://ericcoulombe.com/selling.html): how Eric works with buyers and sellers.
- [Eric's listings](https://ericcoulombe.com/mylistings.html): current and sold listings.

## Market data
- [Market Insight hub](https://ericcoulombe.com/market-insight.html): monthly 20-second Vancouver market update by property type.
- [The Split Market](https://ericcoulombe.com/vancouver-market-report.html): quarterly Vancouver market report with scenarios and signposts.
- [UBC market stats](https://ericcoulombe.com/ubc-market-stats.html): UBC benchmark prices, sales and listings, updated monthly.
- [Neighbourhood market stats](https://ericcoulombe.com/neighbourhood-market-stats.html): stats for 15 Vancouver neighbourhoods, from the Westside to the East Side.
  - [Point Grey](https://ericcoulombe.com/point-grey-market-stats.html), [Dunbar and MacKenzie Heights](https://ericcoulombe.com/dunbar-mackenzie-heights-market-stats.html), [Kerrisdale](https://ericcoulombe.com/kerrisdale-market-stats.html), [Arbutus](https://ericcoulombe.com/arbutus-market-stats.html), [Kitsilano](https://ericcoulombe.com/kitsilano-market-stats.html), [Fairview](https://ericcoulombe.com/fairview-market-stats.html) and [Downtown, Yaletown, Coal Harbour and West End condos](https://ericcoulombe.com/downtown-peninsula-market-stats.html): Westside and downtown neighbourhoods. Benchmark prices, sales and listings, updated monthly.
  - [Cambie](https://ericcoulombe.com/cambie-market-stats.html), [Mount Pleasant](https://ericcoulombe.com/mount-pleasant-market-stats.html), [Main Street](https://ericcoulombe.com/main-street-market-stats.html), [Fraser](https://ericcoulombe.com/fraser-market-stats.html), [Grandview-Woodland](https://ericcoulombe.com/grandview-woodland-market-stats.html), [Strathcona](https://ericcoulombe.com/strathcona-market-stats.html) and [Downtown East: Gastown, Chinatown and the Downtown Eastside](https://ericcoulombe.com/downtown-east-market-stats.html): central and East Side neighbourhoods. Benchmark prices, sales and listings, updated monthly.

## Investment properties
- [Start here: rental houses that pay you to own them](https://ericcoulombe.com/investing.html): leveraged, cash-flow-first small multi-family investing explained.
- [Leverage, explained](https://ericcoulombe.com/investment-properties-northern-bc.html): cap rate, cash flow, debt coverage and loan-to-value, worked through on one house.
- [One house, fifteen years](https://ericcoulombe.com/one-house-fifteen-years.html): one C$565,000 suited house over 15 years, spending, splitting or reinvesting the cash flow.
- [The Spinning Wheel](https://ericcoulombe.com/spinning-wheel.html): buy, hold, refinance, redeploy. What recycling equity adds over 15 years on the same house, five stress tests, the operating rules, and an interactive calculator.
- [Fort St. John investor brief](https://ericcoulombe.com/fort-st-john-investor-brief.html): the economic drivers, rents and risks behind Fort St. John cap rates.
- [Current opportunities](https://ericcoulombe.com/investmentproperties.html): investment properties on the market now.
- [Our Portfolio](https://ericcoulombe.com/our-portfolio.html): two of our own rentals (Kitimat and Fort St. John) by the numbers, with cash flow and internal rate of return to date and forecast.
